text:
olivia: starting deploy for inference-gateway v3.0 during midnight quiet window. plan: feature flag route_llm_v3 ramp: 0 -> 0.02 (canary 5 hosts) -> 0.2 -> 0.5 -> 1.0 over ~40m with gates at each step. pin enterprise users to model=v2.8 and keep legacy routing for them until final approval. release notes: https://internal.redwood/releases/2026-03-23/gateway-v3.0

raj: ack. add deploybot holdpoint after canary and before 0.2. gates: error_rate > 1.8% OR p95 latency +30% OR cost per token > +10% -> pause and notify oncall. enable session soft-drain 8m for canary hosts. :thumbsup:

deploybot: automated: created canary cluster C (5 hosts). route_llm_v3 set to 0.02. telemetry stream: /ops/telemetry/deploy/7654321987 active. scheduled holdpoint at step 2.

tia: smoke tests (smoke_basic) and eval set (regression_suite_A) running against canary. quality gate: bleu_delta <= 0.8% and exact-match loss <= 1.2%

olivia: note - we also watch fallback-rate (how often runtime falls back to v2) and cache hit degradation. if fallback-rate > 3% we abort.

raj: rollback snippet for quick ops copy:
```
# immediate rollback to previous flag state
curl -X PATCH -H 'Authorization: Bearer $DEPLOY_TOKEN' https://api.redwood/flags/route_llm_v3 -d '{"value":0}'
# then trigger deploybot drain for canary C
deploybot action: drain --cluster canaryC --grace 480
```

deploybot: canary C metrics @ +6m: error_rate=0.6% p95=230ms (+12%) token_cost=+6% fallback_rate=0.7% smoke_basic OK, regression_suite_A delta=+0.3% (within threshold). Proceeding to 0.2 in 7m.

olivia: pinging support@ and #eng-oncall. FYI: release notes will be staged to #release-notes after final gate. also added a short note about model pinning in the runbook.

infra-bot: autoscale headroom added: +20% GPU capacity scheduled at +15m.

raj: if anything flaps I will fast-drain and pin routing back to v2.8 for enterprise. also will flip canary to maintenance if any noisy neighbor shows up.

deploybot: scheduled promote to 1.0 at 00:45 UTC unless gate trips. holdpoint active at step 2.

tia: pre-emptive checklist: traces enabled, sampling 5% of responses to logstore, eval alerts to #model-quality. good to go from my side. :white_check_mark:

olivia: thanks all. will keep an eye on p50/p95 and quality. next update in 10m or earlier if any gate trips.
